description: This is a test source file for the class EnforcedThingFlattener. It contains unit tests that verify the behavior of the flattening functionality with different types of enforcers (ACL and policy enforcers), feature and definition handling, attribute cleanup, and array size constraints.

classes.name: EnforcedThingFlattenerTest
classes.description: A set of unit tests verifying the behavior of EnforcedThingFlattener, including handling of ACL and policy enforcers, feature and definition extraction, null/empty attribute handling, and array size constraints.

methods.name: testWithAclEnforcer
methods.description: Verifies that the EnforcedThingFlattener correctly flattens a JSON object when an ACL enforcer is used, mapping access control policies into flattened structures.

methods.name: testWithPolicyEnforcer
methods.description: Verifies that the flattener correctly processes a JSON object with a policy enforcer, including subject and permission annotations.

methods.name: testFeatures
methods.description: Checks that features within the JSON are expanded into flattened entries, including wildcards for property paths.

methods.name: testDefinition
methods.description: Verifies that the 'definition' attribute is correctly extracted and flattened.

methods.name: testNullOrEmptyAttributes
methods.description: Tests the handling of null, empty, and nested null attributes within the 'attributes' object, ensuring they are flattened appropriately.

methods.name: testZeroMaxArraySize
methods.description: Checks that array attributes are truncated or flattened according to the maximum array size constraint (set to zero in this test).

methods.name: flattened
methods.description: Helper method to create a standardized flattened JSON value with specified path and value.
